title: Next Big Idea Club Names Incorruptible a May 2026 Must-Read
summary: Incorruptible earns a Next Big Idea Club Must-Read selection for May — the recognized curation badge from a panel of four heavyweight authors (Malcolm Gladwell, Susan Cain, Adam Grant, Daniel Pink). NBIC's monthly picks are widely watched in business and ideas publishing.
blockquote: I'm excited to introduce a new batch of standout nonfiction, the most compelling and thought-provoking titles scheduled for release in May 2026.
blockquote_source: Next Big Idea Club — May 2026 Must-Read Books
attribution_title: Curation by Malcolm Gladwell, Susan Cain, Adam Grant, and Daniel Pink
